title: A quadratically enriched count of lines on a smooth del Pezzo surface of degree 5
summary: In this paper, we give an enriched count for the 10 lines on a smooth del Pezzo surface S of degree 5 as the quadratic degree of the Euler class of a locally free sheaf. To do this, we see S as a section of the quintic del Pezzo threefold V 5 and the lines on S as a sub-scheme of the P 2 of lines on V 5 . We then use some oriented Schubert calculus and Bott residue formula with N SL 2 -action to compute the degree of the Euler class.
